## Why visit

Use the Wharf when you want a substantial meal, a broad cask choice and a sense of Manchester’s canal geography in the same stop. Its setting beside Castlefield Basin earns the detour even when November weather limits time outside. This is a spacious, traditional-style food pub, so come for the combination of beer, lunch and surroundings rather than an intimate drinking den. It makes a useful anchor for a Castlefield walk before continuing to Cask on Liverpool Road or the historic pubs around Deansgate.

## Beer

CAMRA documents a broad rotating cask range and twelve handpumps, while explaining that the number of beers available varies with demand and day. Do not assume all pumps are in use.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly lists real cider, with the range varying. Ask which producer is currently available; no permanent cider is established.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Food

Daily food menus include substantial pub dishes and vegetarian/vegan choices; Sunday menus are published separately. Reserve a table if planning a meal.

## Plan the visit

CAMRA records refurbishment in January 2026 and a June 2026 update. Weekend breakfast or brunch opening does not by itself establish early beer service. Check kitchen and bar hours separately.

**Getting there:** Approach from Deansgate railway station or Deansgate–Castlefield Metrolink; combine with a Castlefield canal walk and Cask Liverpool Road.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
